messages.subject: error
parts:
Hello!
I have being trying to create a project using DISTANCE 4.0 release 2. Each
time I obtain the following error number Error number 429. The program says
that ActiveX component can not create object. I shall appreciate any help
to solve this problem.
Sincerely,
Francisco Cabrera

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: error
parts:
Hi Francisco,

I haven't seen this error before. It sounds like something isn't installed
properly on your machine. This kind of problem is rare, but is often difficult
to fix without having the machine in front of me. Usually, what has happened is
that some other program you have installed has overwritten a support file that
Distance needs, either with an older version of the file or there was a newer
version of a file that is not compatible with the one Distance is used to using.

I can have a go at diagnosing exactly what the problem might be if you tell me:
- what operating system you're using (including what language it's in)
- what other programs you have on the computer
- exactly where the error occurs (what screen you are on and what button you
press just before it happens)
- if possible send me a picture of the screen with the error message on (use a
screen capture tool to save it as a computer image), or write down the exact
text of the error message
- send me a copy of the file install.log from your Distance program directory

Send these to me at dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk

As a temporary work-around, try:
- re-installing Distance (it probably won't make any difference, but you never
know)
- installing the program on another computer

Thanks!

- Len
